name: Spherical Volume Ray Walking
aliases: Amanatides and Woo extension to spherical grids
Fast Voxel Traversal Over Spherical Grids
definition: An algorithm that walks a ray through a spherical voxel grid by iterating through radial, polar, and azimuthal voxel boundaries to determine the sequence of voxels intersected by the ray.
summary: Spherical Volume Ray Walking is a fast voxel traversal algorithm for spherical grids that handles curved boundaries using line-sphere and 2D segment intersections, unlike axis-aligned methods.
